dedupe_keys.name: enabling hierarchical control of coherent pluggable transceivers in sonic packet optical nodes

description: Cugini and colleagues document this resource in the B5G-OPEN community. An exact-title registered abstract describes two designed and validated hierarchical SDN solutions for coherent optical pluggables in hybrid packet-optical nodes. An experimental testbed contains two nodes running an extended SONiC system and measures end-to-end connection setup across packet and optical layers. Coverage is this prototype control study; a companion demonstration adds packet-routing protocol coordination and failure recovery. The source does not establish publication of the particular SONiC extensions or adoption of a completed cross-layer standard. Zenodo provides the descriptive publication with open access; its stated licence is cc-by-4.0. Its publication licence does not establish a code licence or source-code availability. A limitation is that the native metadata do not establish all implementation settings, uncertainty bounds or independent reproducibility. Only descriptive metadata were inspected. Related records and companion papers retain their source-defined roles; they do not imply independent measurements. The control model supports coordinated service provisioning across packet and optical layers.
